title: Presentation outline

body.text: Have the AI lay out a slide structure from
the presentation's goal + the audience + the time available
— you get a smooth narrative flow, with a main point per slide and speaker notes.

example: "Lay out a 10-minute presentation pitching a new project to executives: opening hook → problem → solution → numbers → ask for approval"

title: One slide, one idea

body.text: A rule the AI enforces well:
each slide has a single point, and the title is a sentence that communicates on its own
— ask it to change a title from 'Q3 Sales' to a sentence like 'Q3 sales grew 23%, the highest in two years'.

example: "Rewrite every slide title in the outline into a sentence that conveys the main point without reading the body"

question: What information helps the AI build a good presentation outline?

options.text: The goal, the audience, and the time available

question: What should a good slide title be like?

options.text: A sentence that conveys the main point on its own

question: What does the 'one slide, one idea' rule help with?

options.text: The audience grasps the point without getting lost

question: When making a presentation outline, what's the good principle?
What does a presentation outline help with?

options.text: Ordering the story so it flows smoothly
